As a response to increasing tensions in Ukraine and what may end up being a Nuclear conflict, China is taking a preemptive measure and deploying its missile defense systems, particularly its ballistic missile defense systems.

China has been secretive about its missile defense capabilities, but with the 2010 Anti-Ballistic Missile Test China proved that it could destroy a ballistic missile beyond Earth’s atmosphere, they are thought to be quite potent. With many types of SAM capabilities such as the HQ-9 and variants thereof that are more suited to anti-ballistic operations, defense systems are beginning to be seen around the country.

Chinese citizens were largely unaware that this was anything other than a drill until an unknown journalist leaked the news to the public. Officials in the People’s Liberation Army have assured the populace that the defense systems will “almost certainly be unnecessary”, and assure the people of China that the missile defense systems are “more than capable” of handling any threat that may come their way, however unlikely this will be. Citizens are still on edge, however.
Norway is off put by this, however we understand that the Chinese government has a right to protect its sovereignty and its people.
Pakistan is concerned about this development, but understands China's right to self-defence.

Japanese Defense Experts find this turn of events to be increasingly disturbing and are on edge about the readying of China's Missile 'Defense' System. (Japan is all too familiar with Defense.) Japan does not condone the readying of military installations as it is more likely to increase tensions here in Asia than not. Japan expressed these concerns to the EAC with Chinese Delegates, expressing the desire for joint communication between the two nations when such actions may occur.

China is puzzled by Japan's attitude towards this. The photographs shown in the articles clearly indicate HQ-9 and HQ-19 missiles. Both of these are Surface-to-Air missiles. They are anti-ballistic, particularly HQ-19 which is specifically designed with anti-ballistic measures in mind.

We understand Japan's concerns about China's armament, but the fact that all that we have readied is our anti-ballistic missile capabilities makes the idea that we're about to prepare an attack laughable. Indeed, the insinuations of out anti-ballistic Missile 'Defense' Systems not being defensive at all is, to put it bluntly, preposterous, considering they are specifically Surface-to-Air and are designed and deployed to protect against incoming ballistic missiles. Surely Japan would not prefer China leave itself open to the stray ICBM? After all, it would appear that a war between Russia and the west is about to unfold...

We are frankly amazed that Japan is not taking the tensions in Eastern Europe more seriously. It could well explode into a nuclear conflict, and Japan would do well to protect itself from any errant missiles. In fact, China encourages Japan to deploy its RIM-161 anti-ballistic missiles across the country to shield itself should the conflict in Ukraine become a nuclear cataclysm.
We can assure China that the situation is contained and that nuclear war is nowhere near happening.
We hope this will be the case, and thank the US for its assurances. We would still prefer to be safe rather than sorry.
